channel.title: Lastbrowser Releases & Changelog
channel.description: Offizieller Release- und Update-Feed für Lastbrowser – Der AI-native Windows-Browser.

item.title: Lastbrowser v0.1.42 Beta – Persistent goals and provider stability
item.description:
v0.1.42 preserves evidence across persistent goal turns and protects active goals during resume and replacement. The packaged app passed live Ollama Cloud chat, Teamwork, cancellation, and goal-reload checks.

  • Setup and portable installers are Authenticode-signed and timestamped; the browser package passed Widevine VMP verification.
  • See the published release notes and downloads.

item.title: Lastbrowser v0.1.41 Beta – Stability and Teamwork reliability updates
item.description:
v0.1.41 is a previous published Windows release. It includes a Teamwork fallback-pool correction, Python runtime reuse across app-version updates, and clearer access-authentication status.

  • Setup and portable installers are Authenticode-signed and timestamped.
  • See the published release notes and downloads.

item.title: Lastbrowser v0.1.38 Beta – Stability and provider updates
item.description:
v0.1.38 was a previous published Windows release, with stability and provider fixes since v0.1.34.

  • The GitHub release includes Windows setup and portable packages.
  • See the published release notes for details.

item.title: Lastbrowser v0.1.34 Beta – Multi-Account Spaces & Castlabs Widevine DRM L3
item.description:
Neuerungen in Version 0.1.34 Beta:

  • Multi-Account Spaces: Vollständige Session-Isolation (Cookies, Cache, Storage) pro Space über persist:profile:space.
  • Castlabs Electron Widevine DRM L3: Native DRM-Unterstützung für Spotify, Netflix und Streaming-Dienste.
  • ConPTY Terminal Doctor: Automatische Fehlerdiagnose für lokale Entwicklungsumgebungen im integrierten PowerShell-Terminal.
  • 48 Agentic Workflows: Direkte Einbindung externer Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server.

item.title: Lastbrowser v0.1.33 Beta – ConPTY Terminal & Split-View Polish
item.description:
Neuerungen in Version 0.1.33 Beta:

  • Echtes ConPTY Windows Pseudo-Terminal in der Seitenleiste.
  • 70/30 Split-Screen Ansicht für Recherche und paralleles Schreiben.
  • Leistungsverbesserungen beim Rendern von Markdown-Tabellen.

item.title: Lastbrowser v0.1.32 Beta – Nova AI Copilot & BYOK Integration
item.description:
Neuerungen in Version 0.1.32 Beta:

  • Nova AI Copilot mit anpassbarer Mentalität und Rollenkonfiguration.
  • Konfigurierbare KI-Provider und lokale Ollama-Modelle für Nova AI.
  • Lokale DPAPI-Verschlüsselung aller API-Keys im Windows Credential Manager.
